findings.title: 404 'Commande introuvable' on GET /api/admin/delivery-boy/cash-sessions/9999 — wrong i18n key
findings.evidence: curl GET /api/admin/delivery-boy/cash-sessions/9999 returned {"success":false,"code":"ORDER_NOT_FOUND","message":"Commande introuvable."} STATUS 404. Should return CASH_SESSION_NOT_FOUND or DELIVERY_CASH_SESSION_NOT_FOUND with a session-specific message.
findings.impact: Misleading error message for ops/dev troubleshooting. No functional impact (404 is correct).
findings.fix_hint: DeliveryBoyCashSessionController::show() route-model-binding 404 handler — return code=CASH_SESSION_NOT_FOUND + 'Caisse livreur introuvable.'

findings.title: BranchScope sentinel does not list DeliveryBoyCashSession/DeliveryBoyCashMovement by name
findings.evidence: BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest.php greps EXEMPTED_MODELS const but does not specifically list cash-session/movement models. Models DO carry BranchScope (verified at runtime — both report 1 scope=App\Models\Scopes\BranchScope). Sentinel works by enumerating Models/, but explicit listing would harden against silent removal.
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth gap; current protection is real.
findings.fix_hint: Add to BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest::REQUIRED_MODELS if a hard whitelist exists, otherwise document in CLAUDE.md §9 baseline list.
